snippet.title: Nox Mortalis - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive through the night.

Play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2520400
